programs.effectiveChanges: TY2026: the indexed base is $4,873 and the total-assessed-value cap no longer applies to veteran claimants (ARS 42-11111(H) indexing; HB 2792 / HB 2120). TY2027 amounts will be published by ADOR by December 31, 2026 (statute: 'On or before December 31 of each year, the department shall increase the following amounts'). Pending 2026 bills on 42-11111 (SB1268, SB1365, HB2841, HB2973, SB1130) were introduced; no primary source shows any of them chaptered.
programs.note: The `details` string is stale (TY2025 base and a cap that no longer applies to veterans); the `summary` is current. Tiers use the lower bound of each 10-point band, so a 95% veteran is modeled at 90%; acceptable approximation, or compute 4,873 x rating / 0.10 directly.

programs.name: 100% T&P Disabled Veteran Full Exemption

type.quote: The primary residence of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose disability rating by the United States department of veterans affairs is one hundred percent is fully exempt from taxation.

requiresSchedular100.quote: is one hundred percent or whose disability status is total disability based on individual unemployability is fully exempt from taxation

survivingSpouse.quote: The primary residence of a widow or widower who is the surviving spouse of a veteran who was eligible for the exemption under subsection C of this section is fully exempt from taxation.

ptRequired.quote: whose disability rating by the United States department of veterans affairs is one hundred percent

effective date.quote: This act applies to tax years beginning from and after December 31, 2025. ... APPROVED BY THE GOVERNOR FEBRUARY 12, 2026.

primary residence limit.quote: a primary residence that is owned by a veteran who is eligible for the exemption under this subsection and the veteran's spouse shall be treated as if owned solely by the veteran. ... APPROVED BY THE GOVERNOR JUNE 4, 2026.

programs.effectiveChanges: In force for TY2026 (tax years beginning after Dec 31, 2025). ADOR: existing claimants need no new application; new claimants file between the first Monday in January and March 1. Surviving-spouse continuation can first be claimed in January 2027 (veteran received the exemption in 2026 and died in 2026), per ADOR FAQ.
programs.note: Row name says 'T&P' but P&T status is not required (100% schedular or TDIU qualifies); consider renaming. survivingSpouse should be true: ARS 42-11111(F) and ADOR FAQ ('The surviving spouse must not remarry'). Income test does not apply to this tier.
